title: The Barrow Bride
text: A woman in a wedding dress, centuries out of fashion, waits at a barrow's door. Her veil is cobweb and her bouquet is dust. She has been waiting for a groom who never came, and she turns to each of you with the same hopeful face.

options.label: The kindest sits with her and listens, so that someone finally hears her out.

outcomes.text: She tells her story through the night, and at dawn she lifts her veil and fades, at peace at last.

options.label: The most charming offers to be her groom, though only in jest.

outcomes.text: She laughs, a sound like dry leaves, and presses her ring into their hand. It is very cold.
She takes them at their word. Her cold fingers close around theirs, and she does not let go, not ever.

options.label: Pass her by. Her groom is long dead, and so is she.

outcomes.text: She asks if you have seen him, and asks again, and keeps asking, long after you are out of earshot.
